elements.label: Hover highlight row moving across the Impact field preview (value rows then the Impact select)

elements.manual_reason: The mouse cursor has no candidate box; it travels from the value rows up past the Impact select towards the panel close button.
elements.label: Mouse cursor

pattern.description: Real screen-recorded cursor sweeps over the Columns field preview; each row it passes shows a grey hover band and drag handle, then it exits towards the panel close control.
pattern.why_premium: Minor beat; the hover band confirms the rows are interactive without any added graphics, keeping the demo honest and legible.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {x: 0, y: -120, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power1.out'}); tl.set('.row.hover', {className: 'row'}, '<'); hover band toggled per row with tl.set (no tween).
build_hint.remotion: Cursor position via interpolate(frame, [0, 5], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); hover background as a boolean of which row the interpolated cursor y falls in (hard toggle, no spring).

notes: Tiny event (about 130 ms). The filmstrip is a crop of the panel; the hover band is the only UI change. Cursor manual box is placed at its end-frame location near the close X.
